changes.text: 魏安釐王二十年，秦军击破赵长平军之后，进兵围住邯郸。魏王派将军晋鄙带十万众救赵。平原君的使者冠盖相属，赶到魏国责让魏公子：平原君说，自己之所以与公子结为婚姻，是看重公子的高义，以为公子能急人之困；如今邯郸旦暮之间就要降秦，而魏国的救兵至今不到，公子能急人之困又在哪里？末了还添一句「獨不憐公子姊邪」。魏公子的姐姐，正是平原君夫人。

In the twentieth year of King Anxi of Wei, after Qin had broken Zhao's army at Changping, its armies pressed on and encircled Handan. The king of Wei sent General Jin Bi with a hundred thousand troops to relieve Zhao. Envoys from Lord Pingyuan arrived in Wei one after another — caps of office and carriage canopies in an unbroken line — reproaching the Wei prince: Lord Pingyuan said he had joined himself to the prince by marriage because he valued the prince's high sense of duty and believed him a man who would rush to others in distress; now Handan was within days of surrendering to Qin, and Wei's relief still had not come — where, then, was that readiness to rush to others in distress? They added, in translation: had he no pity for his own sister? The prince's elder sister was Lord Pingyuan's wife.
平原君的使者在魏国把话说绝：救兵不到，公子的高义安在。他决意赴秦军而死。
Lord Pingyuan's envoys left nothing to the imagination in Wei: with no relief army in sight, where was the lord's famed righteousness? He resolved to go and die against the Qin army.
第三处是事后的账。门客那句「於趙則有功矣，於魏則未為忠臣也」把两边算清：功劳是赵国的，亏欠是魏国的。原文只记他立自责，未记辩解之辞；另记退秦存赵之后，他遣军归魏、自己与门客留赵。作者推断，这是用离开把这笔债认下来（原文只写留赵这一行为，也未交代它与五城之议、自责孰先孰后）。一种解释是，他先有居功之色，受劝后立即自责，这一转与留赵相呼应。

The third is the accounting afterward. The retainer's words — in translation, a service to Zhao but not the act of a loyal minister to Wei — keep both columns straight: the credit belongs to Zhao, the debt to Wei. The source records only that he blamed himself on the spot, and nothing of any argument; it also records that, once Qin was driven off and Zhao saved, he sent the army home to Wei and stayed in Zhao with his retainers. The author infers that this acknowledged the debt through departure (the source records only the act of staying in Zhao, and does not say whether it came before or after the five-city offer and the self-reproach). One reading: he first showed a look of self-congratulation, then blamed himself at once when rebuked, and this turn chimes with his staying in Zhao.
魏王怒公子盗兵符、矫杀晋鄙，公子自己清楚。退秦存赵之后，他派将领率军归魏，自己与门客留在赵国。这场救赵中盗符夺军、矫杀晋鄙的一段没有魏王的授权。

The king of Wei was furious that the prince had stolen his tally and killed Jin Bi on a forged order, and the prince knew it. Having driven off Qin and saved Zhao, he had a general lead the army back to Wei and stayed behind in Zhao with his retainers. The part of the rescue of Zhao in which he stole the tally, seized the army and killed Jin Bi carried no royal authorization.
今天最常见的版本是：团队看到明显风险，决策层迟迟不动。你手里有一线证据，也有一个能干的人。先别急着感动自己——照侯生的话问一句，我这个动作是解决问题，还是拿肉投餒虎？如果只是冲出去把话说完、把人得罪完，而风险一点没减，那叫白送。

The commonest modern version: a team sees a clear risk, while the people with authority will not move. You hold a piece of hard evidence and you know a capable person. Before you start admiring your own nerve, put Hou Ying's question to your plan: is this move solving the problem, or throwing meat to a starving tiger? If all it does is get you out there to say your piece and offend everyone while the risk sits exactly where it was, that is a free throwaway.

dispositions.rationale: 证据只写使者往来“於魏”，未写大梁。中文改为“赶到魏国”，英文同步改为“arrived in Wei”。

evidence.quote: 平原君使者冠蓋相屬於魏

dispositions.rationale: 地点收窄为证据所写的“魏”。中文改为“在魏国把话说绝”，英文同步改为“in Wei”。

evidence.quote: 平原君使者冠蓋相屬於魏

dispositions.rationale: 中英两版同步删去“亲迎在前、劝谏自责在后”的定序表述。原文没有交代这两件事的时间先后，删去后也与同段括注一致。

evidence.quote: 趙王及平原君自迎公子於界

dispositions.rationale: 英文由复数的“sent the generals back”改为“had a general lead the army back to Wei”。中文同步改为“派将领率军归魏”，与原文用语对应。
现存证据不支持魏王因惧怕更强对手而按兵不动，因此删去“因为怕更大的对手”。中文改为“决策层迟迟不动”，英文同步改为“the people with authority will not move”。
原文中“能急人之困”是平原君说明自己与公子结为婚姻的理由，属于他对公子的看重，不是公子的自我标榜。中英文都删去“自命”和“prided himself”，改为平原君的说法，并据此反问公子能急人之困在哪里。

evidence.quote: 勝所以自附為婚姻者，以公子之高義，為能急人之困
